item.title: 1,000 Agents and One Shared Database: Reproducing a Formal Proof of Fermat's Last Theorem with Claude Fable 5.2
item.description: How 1,000 agents running an early version of Claude Fable 5.2 reproduced a Lean proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 28.7 hours without a dedicated platform or a researcher steering them, focusing on the shared database the team coordinated through and the sandbox and two monitors that contained it.

item.title: Effort Is Verification Time, Not Intelligence: Choosing Claude Code Effort Levels
item.description: What Claude Code’s effort setting actually changes under the hood, where low and max diverge, and how Thariq Shihipar’s experiments map effort levels to real engineering work.
